Vector graphics and geo data are dense in long decimal fractions. The digits
AFTER the decimal point are not a card number, even when they happen to satisfy
Luhn and carry a major-network IIN prefix — the fraction below is the classic
Visa test number pushed behind a dot, which is exactly what an SVG emits.
